description: Turns CSS variable / attribute overrides of a component into copy-paste code: a CSS class, HTML + <style>, a Lit subclass registered under your own tag, or JSON. Validates variable and attribute names against the component API. Start from a curated preset with `preset`, or from a gallery card with `example` (its slug or label).

css.description: Component CSS variables to fix, e.g. {"--c2-button__container--background-color": "var(--c2-theme--color-error)"}

example.description: Gallery card to start from, by slug or label (get_examples view: index): its themed variables for this component are merged under `css`

html.description: Base markup; defaults to the example or preset markup, else `<tag>Label</tag>`

name.description: Class / tag name of the variant (kebab-case, must contain a hyphen, not c2-*)

preset.description: Name of a curated preset to start from (its values are merged under `css`)

tag.description: Component tag, id or package: `c2-button`, `button`, `@c2n/button`, `c2-tab`, or a concrete icon tag such as `c2-feather-arrow-right`

name: generate_variant
title: Generate a variant component
